 Print School holiday today, November 16: Delhi, Bihar and Bengal schools shut, check Noida and NCR updates Chhath Puja 2026 School Holiday: Schools across Delhi, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal will remain closed today, November 16, 2026, on account of Chhath Puja. Several districts of Uttar Pradesh have also announced school holidays for the festival. The closures cover government, government-aided and private institutions in areas where local administrations or education departments have issued holiday orders. However, schools in Noida and several other parts of the National Capital Region (NCR) are not observing a compulsory statewide holiday. Institutions in these areas are continuing with regular or hybrid classes, depending on their individual decisions. Parents and students have been advised to check official school communications before travelling to their campuses. Delhi, Bihar and Jharkhand school holiday details In Delhi, all government, government-aided and recognised private schools are closed following a circular issued by the Directorate of Education (DoE). Regular classes are scheduled to resume on November 17. Bihar is observing an extended festive break, with schools remaining shut until November 17. Academic activities are scheduled to restart on November 18. The holiday forms part of the state's arrangements for Chhath Puja celebrations. Schools across Jharkhand are also closed today. However, the duration of the festive break varies between institutions, with some school boards observing holidays through November 16 and others extending the closure until November 17. West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh school closure status West Bengal has declared November 16 an additional state holiday for Chhath Puja. Schools across the state will therefore remain closed. In Uttar Pradesh, the holiday arrangements differ by district. November 16 is a restricted holiday rather than a compulsory statewide school holiday. According to The Indian Express, schools in Noida and other NCR areas are continuing with regular or hybrid classes unless their managements have announced a local closure. Join conversation

 Meanwhile, district administrations have declared holidays for schools in Kanpur Nagar, Varanasi, Gorakhpur, Ghazipur, Kushinagar, Ballia, Prayagraj, Deoria, Maharajganj and Sant Kabir Nagar. State-wise school holiday status on November 16 State or region School status 
 Delhi Closed 
 Uttar Pradesh: Noida and NCR Open or hybrid 
 Uttar Pradesh: Listed districts Closed 
 Bihar Closed 
 Jharkhand Closed 
 West Bengal Closed 
 What parents and students should check School closure decisions in Uttar Pradesh may differ between government and private institutions, particularly in cities such as Noida, Ghaziabad and Lucknow. Since November 16 is not a mandatory statewide holiday in the state, parents should check their school's official circular, website or parent portal for confirmation. Students should also verify whether their institution has announced online or hybrid classes before following their usual school schedule.
